name: New York

cover_rules: NY 340: To cut wind erosion, aim for at least 90-percent combined canopy and residue cover during the erosive wind period.
NY 340: Plant as early as possible and end growth as late as practical to maximize plant biomass.
residue: NY 329: Keep a minimum of 60 percent residue cover on the soil surface throughout the year.
windbreak: NY 380: The protected zone on the leeward side is 10 times the maximum design height (H) of the tallest row at age 20.
NY 603: Design barriers for a minimum expected height of 1.5 feet and porosity of 40 to 50 percent; space barriers no more than 10 times height.
